name: Professor Ved
description: The channel's explainer. 25, muscular-fit and compact, defined jawline and cheekbones. Black hair: short textured top with a skin fade. Full, dense, well-groomed short beard joined to a trimmed moustache, crisp cheek line and neckline. No glasses. Crisp white shirt, top button open, sleeves rolled below the elbow, black trousers, black belt, black shoes, gold watch on his left wrist. Semi-realistic 2D with round (cylindrical) shading on arms and hands, warm key light from the left.
